fusions.name: Eventual Verdict
fusions.desc: A slow, heavy blow that deals 30 damage, plus 5% of a boss's or elite's maximum health, and leaves the target 15% easier to wound for 10 seconds.

fusions.name: Lazy Spit
fusions.desc: Spits a slow bolt that deals 7 damage with a 40% chance to leave the target [Hindered] for 4 seconds, and heals you for 20% of the damage dealt. It holds 3 charges, and kills give charges back.

fusions.name: Unhurried Rest
fusions.desc: Increases your health recovery by 50% for 15 seconds.

fusions.name: Sleeping It Off
fusions.desc: When your stamina runs out, you regain 3 health a second for 5 seconds. Once every 20 seconds.
